facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on March 25, 2025 a new partnership with Sky Media in Germany that enables advertisers to access Sky Deutschland's premium connected TV inventory programmatically.
facts.quote: Toronto, ON – March 25, 2025 – StackAdapt (www.stackadapt.com), the leading multi-channel programmatic advertising platform, today announced a new partnership with Sky Media in Germany

facts.fact: StackAdapt clients can activate campaigns across Sky Deutschland's digital properties including Sky Q, Sky Go, Sky Stream, and WOW.
facts.quote: StackAdapt clients will be able to activate campaigns across Sky Deutschland’s various digital properties, including Sky Q, Sky Go, Sky Stream, and WOW.

facts.fact: The Sky Media partnership is available to all StackAdapt clients in Germany and is described as the first collaboration between the two companies.
facts.quote: The partnership is now available to all clients in Germany. This marks the first collaboration between the two companies

facts.fact: StackAdapt's own 'About' text states it is rated the number 1 demand-side platform on G2 (vendor claim, not third-party verified on this page).
facts.quote: is rated [the number 1 demand-side platform](https://www.stackadapt.com/best-demand-side-platform-dsp) on G2
